scope: Actual production Sim2 controls, core clock and route handlers in the supplied CPU recording DOM host; bounded formulas, text transitions and recorded SVG attributes only
limitations: No browser launched; no trusted native input, native range/number sanitization, pointer/touch/AT or browser DOM/layout measurement
CPU recording DOM nodes expose fixed 640x440 rectangles and reduced-motion=true; no responsive/zoom, pixels, screenshots or visual overlap evidence
Sim3 bridge endpoints are CPU stubs in this host; no Three renderer, WebGL/GPU/context recovery or resource/performance acceptance
No formal academic/learner effectiveness acceptance; action oracles are bounded to existing Q0 plans and checks
Source hashes establish byte currentness and replayability, not cryptographic authentication of execution
